text: Nde ɓe yottinnoo ko Yuusufu firtani koyɗol ngol kon, laamɗo on wi'ani gollooɓe mun ɓen: Yaltinee mo ka kaso addanon lam mo. Nde imminaaɗo laamɗo on arunoo ka Yuusufa, o maakani on: Rutto ka koohoojo maa on lanndoɗaa mo fiyaaku rewɓe barminnooɓe juuɗe mon ɗen? Ɗum ko fii no o feññinira o bonnah ado o yaltineede ka kaso. Pellet, Joomi am hino anndi ko ɓe huuwi kon e ɗaɓɓirgol lam bonki. Huunde suuɗaaki Mo e ɗum.
